noiseDeformer
create seed se int 0
seed default 1
seed min 1
seed keyable 1
create amplitude am double 0
amplitude default 1
amplitude keyable 1
amplitude storable 1
create ampOffset aof double 0
ampOffset default 0
ampOffset keyable 1
ampOffset storable 1
create absOn aon bool 0
absOn default 0
absOn keyable 1
absOn storable 1
create frequency fr int 0
frequency default 1
frequency min 1
frequency max 32
frequency keyable 1
frequency storable 1
create smooth sm double 0
smooth default 0.5
smooth keyable 1
smooth storable 1
create space sp double 0
space default 2
space keyable 1
space storable 1
create enableTrasform et bool 0
enableTrasform default 1
enableTrasform keyable 1
enableTrasform storable 1
create centerX cx double 0
centerX default 0
centerX keyable 1
centerX storable 1
create centerY cy double 0
centerY default 0
centerY keyable 1
centerY storable 1
create centerZ cz double 0
centerZ default 0
centerZ keyable 1
centerZ storable 1
create center c compound centerX centerY centerZ
center storable 1
center default 0 0 0
create offsetX ox double 0
offsetX default 0
offsetX keyable 1
offsetX storable 1
create offsetY oy double 0
offsetY default 0
offsetY keyable 1
offsetY storable 1
create offsetZ oz double 0

offsetZ keyable 1
offsetZ storable 1

offset storable 1
offset default 0 0 0
create scaleX sx double 0
scaleX default 1
scaleX keyable 1
scaleX storable 1
create scaleY sy double 0
scaleY default 1
scaleY keyable 1
scaleY storable 1
create scaleZ sz double 0
scaleZ default 1
scaleZ keyable 1
scaleZ storable 1
create scale s compound scaleX scaleY scaleZ
scale storable 1
scale default 1 1 1
create isDropoff ido bool 0
isDropoff default 0
isDropoff keyable 1
isDropoff storable 1
create dropoffType dot enum 0
dropoffType field Constant 0
dropoffType field Linear 1
dropoffType field Quadratic 2
dropoffType keyable 1
dropoffType storable 1
create dropoffRadius dor double 0
dropoffRadius default 5
dropoffRadius keyable 1
dropoffRadius storable 1
create attenuation a double 0
attenuation default 1
attenuation keyable 1
attenuation storable 1
add seed
add amplitude
add ampOffset
add absOn
add frequency
add smooth
add space
add enableTrasform
add center
add offset
add scale
add isDropoff
add dropoffType
add dropoffRadius
add attenuation
